name: pr-shepherd
description: Cross-session PR shepherd backed by Beads. Discovers ready PRs through body backlinks, ignores drafts and release-please PRs, probes review, CI, and conflicts, serializes merges with the Beads merge slot, bounces failures into fix beads, and closes explicitly completing work beads only after verified landing and resolved blockers. Ships a dual-runtime skill, standalone agent, lifecycle steering, and merge probe. Requires gastownhall/beads >= 1.1.0 and gh; inert outside Beads repositories.
